xsec_sources.value: NLO t't'bar at 14 TeV: ~400 pairs produced in 3000 fb-1 at m=2 TeV (=> sigma ~0.13 fb, derived); >30 pairs in 300 fb-1 at 13.6 TeV for m=2 TeV
m_T=1.5 TeV, 14 TeV, BR(T->tS->ttt)=1: 2SS channel 0.0957 fb after pre-cuts (HT>2 TeV), 0.0367 fb after Cut I; ESTIMATE total sigma(TT,1.5 TeV) >~1.5-1.7 fb from pre-cut rate / event fraction
BR(phi+ -> W gamma)/BR(phi+ -> W Z) ~ 1/tan^2(thetaW) ~ 4, i.e. ~80% photon

yield_estimate.6t_2SS_1.5TeV_3ab: 110 signal vs ~0.6 bkg events after Cut I (arXiv:1812.11286 Table 2 x 3000 fb-1; stat-only Delphes study, non-prompt not fully modelled)
yield_estimate.6t_2SS_2TeV_3ab: ESTIMATE ~10 events at BR=1 (400 pairs [2508.14960] x 6.5% 2SS fraction [1812.11286 Tab.1] x 0.38 Cut-I/pre-cut eff at 1.5 TeV [Tab.2]); ~0.6 events at effective BR 25%
yield_estimate.X53_SSL_gamma: No published yield vs background; 1907.05894 Fig.5 gives only 10-signal-event contours. ESTIMATE prompt bkg at 3 ab-1: 45 SSL bkg events at 35.9 fb-1 [1907.05894 Sec.4.1] x 84 x (1e-3..1e-4) photon suppression = ~0.4-4 events, fake photons excluded

backgrounds: 6t: ttW+jets (high-Njet modelling), SM tttt (~13 fb SM at 13 TeV), ttZ, ttH, non-prompt/charge-flip leptons from ttbar. SSL+gamma: ttW-gamma, tt-gamma with fake/non-prompt lepton, jet->gamma and e->gamma fakes (data-driven only).
trigger: Unproblematic: high-pT single/di-lepton plus very large HT (>1-2 TeV); photon pT>200 GeV also self-triggers. Phase-2 L1 track trigger helps, not needed.
pileup: PU 140-200 degrades lepton/photon isolation, b-tag fake rate and jet multiplicity counting (key discriminants: >=5 b, Nj>=8); jet->gamma fake rates in photon isolation most exposed. Mitigated by timing detectors (CMS MTD, ATLAS HGTD) - no quantitative projection found.
detector_upgrades: ITk / CMS Phase-2 tracker (extended eta, b-tag), CMS-TDR-021 L1 trigger with tracking, HGCAL; qualitative benefit only, UNVERIFIED magnitude for this signature.
systematics: ATL-PHYS-PUB-2025-017: tttt measurement systematics-dominated above ~250 fb-1; ttW+jets uncertainty 133% (7j) / 208% (>=8j) in Run-2 resonance search. Signal-region at HT>~2 TeV is stat-limited, so these matter mainly for 1.0-1.5 TeV / hybrid channels.
projection_docs: arXiv:1812.11286 (6t, 3 ab-1 14 TeV, discovery to ~2.5 TeV claimed, stat-only)
arXiv:1907.05894 (SSL recast HL: X5/3->tW 1.19->1.56 TeV naive; SSL+gamma signal contours only)
ATL-PHYS-PUB-2025-017 (tttt and ttH/A, S1/S8 resonances HL projection, not VLQ)
No ATLAS/CMS HL projection for TT->6t or X5/3->t W gamma found
hl_specific_advantage: Both channels are near background-free at m_T>~1.6 TeV, so cross-section sensitivity scales ~1/L (not 1/sqrt L): 3 ab-1 gives ~10x more events than Run-3 300 fb-1 and extends mass reach by a few hundred GeV; SSL+gamma needs O(10) signal events which only HL provides for m>~1.6 TeV.
main_obstacle: QCD pair-production cross section ceiling (~0.13 fb at 2 TeV, 14 TeV) combined with BR dilution in realistic models (effective BR(6t)~25% for Br(T->tS)=50%), against already-strong Run-2 limits (recast 6t: 1.65 TeV; CMS X5/3 1-lepton: 1.63-1.71 TeV) - the open window is ~1.6-2.2 TeV with few events. For SSL+gamma: unknown jet->gamma / e->gamma fake background.
caveats: 1812.11286 is a stat-only Delphes study with limited background generation; its 2.5 TeV reach is optimistic
Recast 1.65 TeV bound (2609.00127 Sec.4, Fig.4a) uses LO MG5+NNLO-NNLL normalization and SUSY/4t SSL searches
Run-3 dedicated search could capture much of the gain before HL-LHC
Sigma at 1.5 TeV is an inferred lower estimate, not a quoted number
